pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: The Voidspace Beetle is an uncommon creature born deep within the earth, its shell carrying traces of mysterious spatial energy. Rarely encountered near the surface, it dwells in subterranean regions far below ordinary habitats. Those seeking it must descend into the depths and search carefully.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: Can appear beneath any Overworld biome, at least 10 blocks below sea level, on solid ground. Has an additional 1-in-5 spawn check.
